description: Search Aura Historia's index of art, antiques and design objects listed by dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms. Use it to find listings by text and by filters such as price, dates, availability, provider, auction, location and shipping. Returns listing summaries in the requested language and currency, with the total when known; pass the returned searchAfter object unchanged to get the next page. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the read scope: watchlist:read, search-filters:read, notifications:read or users:read. Each result's `viewUrl` is the provider link meant to be shared with people: it carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed. `url` is the provider's untagged address. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

amount.description: Amount as an integer in the currency's minor unit (EUR cents; JPY whole yen).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount is in.

max.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

min.description: Start of the range, as an ISO 8601 date-time with offset.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, at most 100; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

distanceOrder.description: Order results by distance from `origin`, `ASC` (nearest first) or `DESC`; requires `origin`.

mode.description: Which locations count when measuring distance: `STRICT` (default) only exact premises, `APPROXIMATE` also street, locality and representative points; `APPROXIMATE` needs `origin` with `radius` or `distanceOrder`.

origin.description: Point that `radius` and `distanceOrder` measure from; required by either of them.

unit.description: Unit of `amount`: one of MILES, YARDS, FEET, INCHES, KILOMETERS, METERS, CENTIMETERS, MILLIMETERS, NAUTICAL_MILES.

radius.description: Only listings within this distance of `origin`, at most 20,000 km.

subdivisions.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, at most 100, that belong to `countries` when those are given; a listing matches when it is located in any of them.

max.description: Highest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

min.description: Lowest price to include, as an integer amount in the currency's minor unit.

fxRateId.description: Exchange-rate snapshot ID (`fx_…`) from the previous page's `searchAfter`, passed back unchanged.

searchAfter.description: Opaque sort values from the previous page's `searchAfter`, passed back unchanged.

collectionOffered.description: Only listings that offer collection in person; the only shipping condition that works without a destination country.

destination.description: Country the listing must ship to, as `{"kind":"COUNTRY","country":"DE"}`; `{"kind":"NONE"}` sets no destination.

interpretation.description: `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_V1` (default) or `WHOLE_COUNTRY_PER_ITEM_FX_V1`, which values `maximumPerItem` in its own currency at the request's exchange rates and requires `maximumPerItem`.

maximumPerItem.description: Highest acceptable shipping price per item, in the amount's own currency; requires a `destination` country. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

referenceRelease.description: Version of the ISO 3166 code list the country code comes from; `iso-codes-4.20.1` is the only accepted value and the default.

service.description: Shipping service code the terms must include, as free text of at most 128 characters; requires a `destination` country.

inputSchema.description: Query options shared by REST extraction and MCP's combined argument envelope.

auctionId.description: Only listings that belong to these auctions, given as auction IDs (`auc_…`).

availability.description: Only listings in one of these exact availability states; combined with `orderability`, a listing must satisfy both.

created.description: Range on the listing's creation time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

currency.description: Currency prices are returned in and `price` is interpreted in, as an ISO 4217 code (default `EUR`).

enhancedSearchDescription.description: Optional natural-language description that refines the ranking of `productQuery` results. Only effective together with `productQuery`; on its own it returns unranked, unrelated results.

excludeListingSourceId.description: Leave out listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

excludeProductListingId.description: Listing IDs (`pl_…`) to leave out of the results.

geography.description: Where listings are located, by country, subdivision or distance from a point; every member given must hold.

includeUnspecifiedAvailability.description: Also include listings that state no availability (default false).

language.description: Language of the returned listing text and of the titles `productQuery` is matched against, as an ISO 639-1 code (default `en`).

listingSourceId.description: Only listings from these providers, given as listing source IDs (`ls_…`).

lotBiddingOpens.description: Range on the time bidding on the lot opens, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

lotScheduledCloses.description: Range on the lot's scheduled closing time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; `min` inclusive, `max` exclusive.

order.description: Sort direction, `asc` or `desc` (default `desc`); only valid together with `sort`.

orderability.description: Only listings whose availability falls into one of these orderability groups; combined with `availability`, a listing must satisfy both.

price.description: Price range in the request's `currency`, with both bounds inclusive. Amounts are always integers in the currency's minor unit when one exists (EUR `119199` = €1,191.99; USD in cents). For currencies without minor units, such as JPY, the amount is whole units (`211453` = ¥211,453). Follow ISO 4217 exponents.

productQuery.description: Keyword phrases matched against listing titles; every word of one phrase must match, and a listing matches when any phrase does.

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: pass back exactly as returned by the previous page, with the same filters and sort.

shipping.description: Only listings whose advertised shipping terms meet these conditions for a destination country; every member given must hold.

size.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100 (default 21); values outside that range are clamped.

sort.description: Field to order results by: `score` (relevance), `updated` or `created`; cannot be combined with `geography.distanceOrder`.

updated.description: Range on the listing's last update time, as ISO 8601 date-times with offset; both bounds inclusive.

name: simpleSearchProductListings

DeliveryAssessmentAttribution.description: Attribution required by the geographic evidence behind the assessed destination.

DeliveryAssessmentExplanation.description: Why eligibility remains undetermined beyond missing caller inputs.

oneOf.description: Partial coverage neither includes nor excludes the destination or service.
A condition depends on a qualifying amount at this scope, which browsing never supplies.
Advertised terms or their seller-side facts cannot be interpreted conservatively.
Collection depends on shipping eligibility, which remains undetermined.
The applicable advertised terms assert no eligibility.

DeliveryAssessmentRequiredInput.description: Inputs a caller can supply whose absence leaves eligibility undetermined.

DeliveryAssessmentSummaryData.description:
Assessed eligibility, or the inputs and explanations leaving it undetermined. Omitted
eligibility means unknown or unasserted; only an explicit `NOT_OFFERED` is a negative.

ListingShippingPriceData.description:
Every advertised price kind. On-request and externally calculated prices stay explicit
rather than becoming an absent or zero price.

ListingShippingSummaryData.description: Destination-independent summary shared by every viewer of a collection item.

ListingTextData.description: A listing text as the source published it and as shown for the requested language.

localized.description:
Text to show for the requested language. Chosen from the translations and the original in
the order requested language, `en`, `de`, then any other language, so it can be the
original itself. Always present; compare its `language` with `original.language` to tell
whether the text was translated.

original.description:
Text as the source published it, normalized: styled letters and digits are presented as
ordinary text, emoji and ornamental symbols are removed and truncation ellipses remain
stable. Omitted where the response does not carry the original, such as search and
similar-listing summaries and notification payloads.

LocalizedTextData.description: Text paired with its public language code.

PersonalizedShippingSummaryData.description: Assessment for the caller's selected browsing destination, without echoing it.

amount.description: Unsigned amount in the currency's minor units.

ProductListingSearchCursorData.description: Public encoding of the ProductListing-owned opaque continuation cursor.

url.description: The provider's own address, without Aura Historia's referral tagging; `viewUrl` is the link meant to be shared.

viewUrl.description: Link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people. It carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed.

PublicListingSourceOperatorData.description: The Party that operates a ListingSource, as shown wherever a source is presented publicly.

partner.description:
`true` while the operator Party has an active Aura Historia Partnership, otherwise
`false`, including after a Partnership is dissolved. Unrelated to ingestion methods and
referral configuration.

ShippingDisplayData.description:
Shared valuation of the requested-currency values in one shipping object. Present only
when a value was actually converted; HalfUp rounding uses currency minor-unit exponents.

ShippingMoneyData.description: Advertised amount in currency minor units; never an authorized quote or checkout total.

ShippingPricePreviewData.description:
One advertised rate of an applicable service in the requested currency where convertible.
It identifies its service and charge basis and never claims a quantity or total.
